name: Human Values and Technology
description: Achievements and detriments of modern technology; modern technology and materialistic worldview; understanding happiness: material pleasures, happiness of achievements, putting a smile on another one's face. Understanding unhappiness. Relationship to one's strengths and weaknesses; working towards cultivating strengths and removing weaknesses; methods of self-development; implications to practical life in individual, societal, environmental, technological spheres.
